ALD conformality is investigated using all-silicon lateral channel structures and an analytical/numerical diffusion model developed to study growth propagation.
The diffusion model calculates film growth by solving the diffusion equation coupled to dynamic Langmuir adsorption and channel narrowing under low-pressure gas transport.
An analytic approximate solution to the diffusion equation enables fitting to experimental thickness profiles to extract the adsorption equilibrium constant and sticking coefficient.
The model agrees well with experimental thickness profiles for Al2O3 and TiO2 ALD processes and is compared against Gordon's plug flow model.
The diffusion model simulations accurately predict experimental thickness profiles in lateral high-aspect-ratio channels for alumina and titania ALD.
